question: How do I navigate the pages?

youtubeLink.caption: Plantour Dashboard
youtubeLink.description: This video explains how to navigate through Plantour pages

sections.title: Use the toolbar as the main navigation
items: The toolbar stays at the top of the page and gives you two main navigation controls: the Dashboard button and the menu button with three horizontal lines.
If you are already signed in, click Dashboard to open the main Plantour dashboard with sections such as Dictionary, Trip, Trip personal, Trip Shared, and General.
Open the dashboard section you need, then click the page link inside it, for example Trips, Trip info, Items, Bags, or Profile.

sections.title: If you are not authenticated
items: Clicking Dashboard sends you to the main public page, because the full dashboard is available only after sign-in.
Use the toolbar menu button with the three horizontal lines (the sandwich menu) to open public pages such as Help, Search, Contact Us, Terms of Usage, and Privacy Policy.
From that same sandwich menu, click Sign In / Sign Up when you want to open your account or continue into the full Plantour dashboard.
